upland.definition: a. used of high or hilly country
upland.translation:
n. 山地, 高地, 高原
a. 高地的, 山地的

uplander.definition:
n. One dwelling in the upland; hence, a countryman; a
   rustic.
n. The upland sandpiper.
uplander.translation: n. 山地, 高地 (upland的变形)

uplanders.definition:
plural of uplander
n. One dwelling in the upland; hence, a countryman; a
   rustic.
n. The upland sandpiper.
uplanders.translation: (uplander 的复数) n. 山地, 高地 (upland的变形)

uplift.definition:
n. a brassiere that lifts and supports the breasts
v. lift up from the earth, as by geologic forces
v. lift up or elevate
uplift.translation:
n. 抬起, 道德的向上, 精神的高涨
vt. 提高, 抬起
vi. 上升

uplifted.definition: s. exalted emotionally especially with pride
uplifted.translation: a. 举起的, 上升的

uplifting.translation:
a. 令人振奋的; 使人开心的
v. 举起(uplift的现在分词)

uplifts.definition:
n (geology) a rise of land to a higher elevation (as in the process of mountain building)
n a brassiere that lifts and supports the breasts
v fill with high spirits; fill with optimism
v lift up from the earth, as by geologic forces
v lift up or elevate
uplifts.translation:
n. 进步( uplift的名词复数 ); 乳罩
v. 举起( uplift的第三人称单数 ); 振作; （社会、道德等）发展; 使上升
